title: Orchestration patterns
summary: Orchestration assigns work and coordinates results across steps or agents.
overview: Fixed workflows prescribe the path; agents can choose it dynamically. Routing, parallel workers, and evaluator loops suit different task structures.
why: Extra coordination adds cost and failure paths.
example: Run independent API and database reviews concurrently, then reconcile their findings.
judgment: Decide whether subtasks are independent enough to justify parallel execution.
next: Does delegation improve measured results over one agent on our workload?
